name: Analyse urbaine générale
description: Vue d'ensemble urbaine : bâtiments catégorisés par usage, routes par nature, espaces verts, hydrographie. Fond IGN pour contexte géographique complet. Produit PDF A3 et carte web interactive.

steps.description: Fond IGN Plan v2 — rues nommées, contexte géographique complet
Styliser les bâtiments par usage (résidentiel, commercial, industriel, équipements...)
steps.code:
from qgis.core import QgsCategorizedSymbolRenderer, QgsRendererCategory, QgsFillSymbol

bat = [l for l in project.mapLayers().values() if 'atiment' in l.name()]
if not bat:
    result['error'] = 'Building layer not found'
else:
    layer = bat[0]
    # Vérifier que le champ usage_1 existe
    fields = [f.name() for f in layer.fields()]
    field = 'usage_1' if 'usage_1' in fields else 'nature'

    usage_colors = {
        'Résidentiel':            ('220,180,130,220', '150,100,60',  '0.2'),
        'Commercial et services': ('255,160,50,220',  '180,90,20',   '0.2'),
        'Industriel':             ('150,160,180,220', '80,90,110',   '0.2'),
        'Sportif':                ('100,200,230,210', '40,130,170',  '0.2'),
        'Religieux':              ('210,170,210,215', '130,80,140',  '0.2'),
        'Enseignement':           ('120,210,130,215', '50,140,70',   '0.2'),
        'Soin':                   ('240,130,130,215', '170,50,50',   '0.2'),
        'Agricole':               ('190,215,130,210', '110,150,65',  '0.2'),
        'Indifférencié':          ('200,195,185,180', '120,115,105', '0.15'),
    }
    cats = []
    for value, (fill, outline, width) in usage_colors.items():
        sym = QgsFillSymbol.createSimple({'color': fill, 'outline_color': outline, 'outline_width': width})
        cats.append(QgsRendererCategory(value, sym, value))
    # Catchall
    sym_other = QgsFillSymbol.createSimple({'color': '195,195,195,170', 'outline_color': '120,120,120', 'outline_width': '0.15'})
    cats.append(QgsRendererCategory('', sym_other, 'Autre'))

    renderer = QgsCategorizedSymbolRenderer(field, cats)
    layer.setRenderer(renderer)
    layer.triggerRepaint()
    result['field'] = field
result['success'] = True

steps.description: Styliser les routes par nature (autoroute → chemin, épaisseur variable)
steps.code:
from qgis.core import QgsCategorizedSymbolRenderer, QgsRendererCategory, QgsLineSymbol

routes = [l for l in project.mapLayers().values() if 'oute' in l.name() or 'Route' in l.name()]
if not routes:
    result['error'] = 'Road layer not found'
else:
    layer = routes[0]
    road_styles = [
        (['Autoroute'],                              '40,40,40,255',   '1.4'),
        (['Quasi-autoroute'],                        '60,60,60,240',   '1.1'),
        (['Bretelle'],                               '80,80,80,220',   '0.8'),
        (['Route à 2 chaussées'],                    '90,90,90,210',   '0.75'),
        (['Route à 1 chaussée'],                     '110,110,110,200','0.5'),
        (['Chemin'],                                 '160,155,145,160','0.22'),
        (['Sentier', 'Escalier', 'Piste cyclable'],  '170,165,155,130','0.15'),
    ]
    cats = []
    for values, color, width in road_styles:
        sym = QgsLineSymbol.createSimple({'color': color, 'width': width})
        for v in values:
            cats.append(QgsRendererCategory(v, sym.clone(), v))
    sym_def = QgsLineSymbol.createSimple({'color': '130,130,130,190', 'width': '0.35'})
    cats.append(QgsRendererCategory('', sym_def, 'Autre'))
    renderer = QgsCategorizedSymbolRenderer('nature', cats)
    layer.setRenderer(renderer)
    layer.triggerRepaint()
result['success'] = True

from qgis.core import QgsFillSymbol, QgsSingleSymbolRenderer
veg = [l for l in project.mapLayers().values() if 'gétation' in l.name() or 'egetation' in l.name() or 'Végétation' in l.name()]
if veg:
    sym = QgsFillSymbol.createSimple({'color': '105,185,85,150', 'outline_color': '60,130,45', 'outline_width': '0.15'})
    veg[0].setRenderer(QgsSingleSymbolRenderer(sym))
    veg[0].triggerRepaint()
result['success'] = True

steps.description: Styliser les cours d'eau (bleu, épaisseur lisible)
steps.code:
from qgis.core import QgsLineSymbol, QgsSingleSymbolRenderer
hydro = [l for l in project.mapLayers().values() if 'eau' in l.name().lower() or 'hydro' in l.name().lower() or 'Hydrographie' in l.name()]
if hydro:
    sym = QgsLineSymbol.createSimple({'color': '50,100,220,220', 'width': '0.9'})
    hydro[0].setRenderer(QgsSingleSymbolRenderer(sym))
    hydro[0].triggerRepaint()
result['success'] = True
